title: Wall corner with a target tucked behind it
description: A ground Wall to the target's north; the attacker looks across its corner.
basis: p. 30 (confirmed: no visible part means no line of sight); readings U77, U78
ruling: The target stands against the wall's south face and the attacker looks past the corner at a steep angle: every one of the nine points is behind the wall, so there is no line of sight and no cover. (Before L2: Partial 1/5 with cover, from a rim point at the full radius; the side points now sit at 0.8 of the radius, U77.)
